brief: Macedonian-language business press for banking regulation clusters into three tiers: two wire-level agencies (Makfax, MIA) that render NBRM Council decisions, resolution-law implementing rules and SEPA/payment-system milestones fastest; a set of business portals and analytical outlets (Kapital and its Manager sub-site, Faktor, Ekonomija i biznis, Pari.com.mk, Biznis Info) that add market structure, rankings and expert reading of draft law; and one genuine sector specialist, Bankarstvo.mk, which is the highest signal-to-noise single feed for this cell. Time.mk is the key pointer layer — a single mk keyword sweep there identifies which outlet broke a story and exposes smaller portals, while Stopanska komora (mchamber.mk) acts as an upstream pointer because draft banking-law amendments circulate to members there before the press reports them. Two named cell outlets (Fokus, Sloboden Pecat) did not surface any banking-regulation articles in this run and are recorded as unverified rather than absent, and notably no MK press report of a specific supervisory sanction was retrieved — either a real reporting gap or a search-index blind spot that a dedicated enforcement pass should resolve. Albanian-language MK media and broadcast/interview formats are the two largest structural gaps left open by this cell's scope.
